content:
Overview

Co-WIN is the digital platform of the Government of India used for registration, scheduling, and certification of COVID-19 vaccination. The platform allowed citizens to register for vaccination, book appointment slots, and download digitally verifiable vaccination certificates. It was developed to manage the world's largest vaccination drive and remains a model for digital public health infrastructure.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Open to all Indian citizens eligible for vaccination as per the government guidelines
  • Registration was done through Aadhaar or other accepted identity documents
  • Vaccination certificates are available to all registered recipients

Benefits

  • Online registration and appointment booking for vaccination
  • Digitally verifiable vaccination certificates with QR codes
  • Real time information on vaccine availability and centres
  • Follow-up reminders for the second dose

How to Apply

  1. Register on the Co-WIN portal or through the Aarogya Setu app
  2. Verify identity and select the vaccination centre and slot
  3. Visit the centre on the scheduled date and receive the dose
  4. Download the vaccination certificate after each dose

Required Documents

  • Aadhaar card or other accepted identity proof
  • Mobile number for registration
meta_title: Co-WIN Portal: Vaccination Registration & Certificates
meta_description: Co-WIN is India's digital vaccination platform for registration, slot booking, and verifiable vaccination certificates. Learn how it works.

content:
Overview

MyGov is the citizen engagement platform of the Government of India that connects citizens with policy making and governance. The platform hosts discussions, polls, contests, and feedback opportunities on government initiatives, allowing citizens to contribute their views. It is a channel for participatory governance under the Digital India programme.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Open to all Indian citizens; registration is free
  • Participation in discussions, polls, and contests requires a MyGov account
  • No eligibility restrictions for engagement activities

Benefits

  • Direct participation in government consultations and surveys
  • Opportunity to contribute ideas for policy making
  • Contests and recognition for citizen engagement
  • Updates on government initiatives and programmes

How to Apply

  1. Register on the MyGov portal with your mobile number
  2. Complete the profile and join groups of interest
  3. Participate in discussions, polls, and contests

Required Documents

  • Mobile number and email ID for registration
meta_title: MyGov: Citizen Engagement with Government of India
meta_description: MyGov is India's citizen engagement platform for discussions, polls, and policy feedback. Learn how to participate and contribute.

content:
Overview

Startup India is a flagship initiative of the Government of India to build a strong ecosystem for start-ups in the country. The initiative provides recognition to eligible start-ups, along with tax benefits, funding support, and easier compliance norms. It includes a dedicated portal, startup hubs, and mentoring programmes to help entrepreneurs grow their ventures.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Entities incorporated as a private limited company, LLP, or registered partnership in India
  • Up to 10 years from incorporation and annual turnover not exceeding Rs 100 crore
  • Working towards innovation, development, or improvement of products, services, or processes

Benefits

  • Recognition as a startup with a certificate from the government
  • Income tax benefits for eligible recognised start-ups
  • Fund of Funds support and access to the startup India network
  • Relaxed compliance and fast track examination for intellectual property

How to Apply

  1. Register on the Startup India portal
  2. Complete the startup recognition application with company details
  3. Submit the required documents and receive the recognition certificate

Required Documents

  • Certificate of incorporation or registration
  • Details of the entity and directors
  • Startup recognition application as per the portal guidelines
meta_title: Startup India: Recognition, Tax Benefits & Funding Support
meta_description: Startup India provides recognition, tax benefits, and funding support to innovative Indian start-ups. Check eligibility and how to register.

content:
Overview

BHIM (Bharat Interface for Money) is a digital payments app developed by the National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI). The app enables instant money transfers between bank accounts using the Unified Payments Interface (UPI), along with bank to bank transfers and Aadhaar payments. It was launched to promote a cashless economy and make digital payments simple and secure for everyone.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Any individual with a bank account in India can use the app
  • The mobile number must be linked to the bank account
  • Aadhaar and UPI enabled bank details are used for payments

Benefits

  • Instant money transfer between bank accounts 24x7
  • Free to use for basic UPI transactions
  • Secure payments with UPI PIN authentication
  • Supports bill payments, merchant payments, and receiving money

How to Apply

  1. Download the BHIM app from the app store
  2. Set up the app with your mobile number and bank account
  3. Create a UPI PIN and start sending or receiving money

Required Documents

  • Bank account with linked mobile number
  • Debit card details for UPI PIN setup
meta_title: BHIM UPI App: Instant Money Transfers Between Banks
meta_description: BHIM is NPCI's UPI app for instant, secure money transfers between bank accounts. Learn how to set up and use BHIM for digital payments.

content:
Overview

The National Knowledge Network (NKN) is a multi-gigabit pan-India network that connects academic and research institutions across the country. The network provides high speed connectivity to universities, research laboratories, libraries, and healthcare institutions, enabling collaboration and sharing of resources. It supports e-education, e-research, and telemedicine through a dedicated national backbone.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Academic and research institutions such as universities, IITs, and national laboratories
  • Healthcare institutions and other knowledge centres can connect to the network
  • Institutions apply through the NKN governance framework

Benefits

  • High speed connectivity for research and academic collaboration
  • Access to shared digital resources and e-libraries
  • Support for distance education and e-learning platforms
  • Enables telemedicine and remote healthcare services

How to Apply

  1. Institutions apply for NKN connectivity through the designated nodal agencies
  2. Submit the application with institution details and requirements
  3. Connectivity is established after approval and technical coordination

Required Documents

  • Institution registration and identity documents
  • Technical requirements and network details
meta_title: National Knowledge Network: High Speed Academic Connectivity
meta_description: NKN connects academic and research institutions with high speed networks for education, research, and telemedicine. Learn about connectivity.

content:
Overview

The Digital India Internship Scheme offers short term internship opportunities to students and young professionals in digital governance projects across the Government of India. Interns work on projects related to digital services, technology implementation, and citizen engagement under the Digital India programme. The scheme provides practical exposure to e-governance and digital public infrastructure.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Students and recent graduates in technology, management, and related fields
  • Age and qualification requirements as per the internship notification
  • Open to Indian citizens through the online application process

Benefits

  • Hands-on experience in digital government projects
  • Stipend and certificate as per the internship guidelines
  • Exposure to policy, technology, and project implementation
  • Networking opportunities with government and technology professionals

How to Apply

  1. Visit the Digital India internship portal
  2. Create a profile and apply for the available internship positions
  3. Complete the selection process and join the assigned project

Required Documents

  • Educational qualification certificates
  • Identity proof and resume
meta_title: Digital India Internship: Internships in E-Governance Projects
meta_description: The Digital India Internship Scheme offers students practical internships in e-governance and digital projects. Check eligibility and apply.

content:
Overview

Bharatmala Pariyojana is a flagship highway development programme of the Ministry of Road Transport and Highways. The programme focuses on developing national highways, economic corridors, and border roads, along with improving connectivity to ports, airports, and logistic hubs. It aims to optimise freight movement across the country and boost economic growth through better road infrastructure.

Eligibility Criteria

  • The programme benefits road users and businesses across the country
  • Projects are implemented by the National Highways Authority of India and state agencies
  • No individual application is required; benefits flow through improved infrastructure

Benefits

  • Development of economic corridors and national highway corridors
  • Better road connectivity to ports, airports, and border areas
  • Reduced travel time and logistics costs for freight movement
  • Improved road safety and connectivity in rural and remote regions

How to Apply

  1. No individual application is required under the programme
  2. Project details and progress are available on the NHAI and ministry portals

Required Documents

  • Not applicable; the programme is implemented as public infrastructure works
meta_title: Bharatmala Pariyojana: National Highway Development
meta_description: Bharatmala Pariyojana develops economic corridors, highways, and border roads to improve freight movement across India. Learn about the programme.

content:
Overview

Sagarmala is a national programme of the Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways for port led development in India. The programme focuses on modernising ports, improving connectivity between ports and hinterland, and developing coastal communities through industries and infrastructure. It aims to reduce logistics cost and time for import and export cargo while creating employment along the coastline.

Eligibility Criteria

  • The programme benefits port users, industries, and coastal communities
  • Projects are implemented through port authorities, state governments, and private partners
  • No individual application is required

Benefits

  • Modernisation and capacity expansion of major and non-major ports
  • Improved road and rail connectivity to ports
  • Development of coastal economic zones and industries
  • Employment generation and livelihood support in coastal regions

How to Apply

  1. No individual application is required under the programme
  2. Businesses can participate in port-led projects through tenders and investment opportunities

Required Documents

  • Not applicable for general beneficiaries
meta_title: Sagarmala Project: Port Modernisation & Coastal Development
meta_description: Sagarmala is India's port-led development programme modernising ports and boosting coastal economies. Learn about the projects and benefits.

content:
Overview

UDAN, or Ude Desh Ka Aam Naagrik, is the regional connectivity scheme of the Ministry of Civil Aviation. The scheme aims to make air travel affordable by connecting underserved and unserved airports through subsidised flights. Airlines operating on UDAN routes receive viability gap funding, and passengers get a cap on fares for a share of seats on these routes.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Passengers on UDAN routes benefit from affordable airfares
  • Regional airports and unserved destinations are prioritised under the scheme
  • Airlines and helicopter operators bid for routes under the UDAN process

Benefits

  • Affordable air travel to regional destinations with capped fares
  • Better connectivity for smaller cities and remote areas
  • Improved regional economic activity and tourism
  • Revival of unserved airports and helipads

How to Apply

  1. Passengers book tickets on UDAN routes through the operating airlines
  2. No separate application is required for availing the capped fares

Required Documents

  • Valid identity proof as required for air travel
meta_title: UDAN Scheme: Affordable Air Travel to Regional Cities
meta_description: UDAN (Ude Desh Ka Aam Naagrik) makes air travel affordable by connecting regional airports with subsidised flights. Learn about the scheme.

content:
Overview

The Smart Cities Mission is a central government programme to develop 100 cities as smart cities with improved infrastructure, services, and quality of life. The mission focuses on area based development, technology adoption, and citizen centric governance in selected cities. Projects include smart mobility, digital services, solid waste management, and safe public spaces.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Residents of the selected smart cities benefit from improved services
  • Citizens participate through the city's smart city portal and consultation processes
  • No individual application is required for most benefits

Benefits

  • Improved urban infrastructure including roads, water supply, and waste management
  • Digital services for civic payments, complaints, and information
  • Smart mobility solutions such as intelligent traffic management
  • Safer public spaces and better disaster response systems

How to Apply

  1. Citizens engage through the smart city portal of their city
  2. Participate in consultations and provide feedback on projects
  3. Avail the digital services as they are rolled out

Required Documents

  • As required for individual civic services
meta_title: Smart Cities Mission: 100 Cities, Smarter Living
meta_description: The Smart Cities Mission develops 100 cities with better infrastructure, digital services, and citizen centric governance. Learn about the mission.

content:
Overview

AMRUT 2.0, the Atal Mission for Rejuvenation and Urban Transformation 2.0, is a central scheme for universal water supply and sewerage services in urban India. The mission aims to provide tap water connections to all households in mission cities and improve sewage treatment capacity. It focuses on water source sustainability, grey water management, and digital monitoring of urban water systems.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Households in AMRUT mission cities are covered
  • Priority for universal tap water connections and sewerage services
  • No income criteria; benefits are extended to all households in the project areas

Benefits

  • Tap water connections for every household in mission cities
  • Improved sewerage and sanitation infrastructure
  • Sustainable water sources and recharge of water bodies
  • Better urban living conditions and reduced waterborne diseases

How to Apply

  1. Households apply for new water connections through the urban local body
  2. Project implementation and connections follow the city's water supply plan

Required Documents

  • Property documents and identity proof as required by the urban local body
meta_title: AMRUT 2.0: Water Supply for Every Urban Household
meta_description: AMRUT 2.0 provides universal tap water connections and improved sewerage in mission cities across India. Learn about the scheme and benefits.

content:
Overview

The Dedicated Freight Corridor (DFC) is a high capacity railway network built exclusively for freight movement in India. Implemented by the Dedicated Freight Corridor Corporation of India (DFCCIL), the project includes the Eastern and Western corridors connecting major industrial and port regions. The corridors enable faster, heavier, and more efficient freight trains, freeing capacity on the passenger network.

Eligibility Criteria

  • The corridors benefit freight customers, industries, and logistics operators
  • Railway freight services on the corridors are open to businesses through the normal booking process
  • No individual application is required

Benefits

  • Faster freight movement with higher train speeds and loads
  • Reduced logistics cost for industries along the corridors
  • Improved utilisation of railway infrastructure
  • Lower carbon footprint compared to road freight

How to Apply

  1. Businesses book freight services through the Indian Railways freight booking system
  2. No separate application is required for corridor usage

Required Documents

  • As required for railway freight booking
meta_title: Dedicated Freight Corridor: High Speed Rail Freight Network
meta_description: The Dedicated Freight Corridor is India's exclusive high capacity rail network for faster, cheaper freight movement. Learn about the project.

content:
Overview

Parivahan Sewa under the National Highways Authority of India (NHAI) provides digital services related to national highways and road infrastructure. The services include highway toll information, e-tolling through FASTag, road condition updates, and grievance redressal for highway users. The platform brings highway related services to the fingertips of citizens and truckers.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Open to all highway users, especially commercial vehicle operators
  • FASTag services are available to all vehicle owners
  • Grievances can be filed by any user of national highways

Benefits

  • FASTag based electronic toll collection reducing waiting time
  • Real time information on tolls and highway services
  • Online grievance redressal for highway related issues
  • Road safety and travel information for highway users

How to Apply

  1. Purchase a FASTag from banks or NHAI authorised points
  2. Register the tag with the vehicle details
  3. Use the Parivahan portal or NHAI app for toll and highway services

Required Documents

  • Vehicle registration certificate
  • Identity proof and bank details for FASTag
meta_title: Parivahan Sewa NHAI: FASTag, Toll & Highway Services
meta_description: NHAI's Parivahan services cover FASTag e-tolling, toll information, and grievance redressal for national highway users. Learn how to use them.

content:
Overview

Setu Bharatam is a programme of the Ministry of Road Transport and Highways for the safety and strengthening of road bridges in India. The programme aims to make all national highways free of railway level crossings by constructing road overbridges and underpasses, and to improve the condition of existing bridges. It enhances road safety and reduces travel delays on the national highway network.

Eligibility Criteria

  • The programme benefits all road users on national highways
  • Projects include bridge strengthening and construction of overbridges
  • No individual application is required

Benefits

  • Removal of railway level crossings on national highways
  • Safer and faster road travel
  • Strengthened bridges with improved load capacity
  • Reduced accidents and travel time at crossings

How to Apply

  1. No individual application is required under the programme

Required Documents

  • Not applicable
meta_title: Setu Bharatam: Safer Bridges & Level Crossing Removal
meta_description: Setu Bharatam removes railway level crossings and strengthens bridges on national highways for safer travel. Learn about the programme.

content:
Overview

The Char Dham Highway Development Project is a road infrastructure initiative to improve connectivity to the four sacred pilgrimage sites of Yamunotri, Gangotri, Kedarnath, and Badrinath in Uttarakhand. The project involves widening and strengthening about 900 kilometres of national highways in the Himalayan terrain. It reduces travel time and improves safety for pilgrims and local communities.

Eligibility Criteria

  • The project benefits pilgrims, tourists, and residents of the region
  • Improved roads serve all users of the Char Dham routes
  • No individual application is required

Benefits

  • Wider and safer highways to the pilgrimage destinations
  • Reduced travel time and improved all-weather connectivity
  • Better access for local communities and economic activity
  • Improved emergency and disaster response in the region

How to Apply

  1. No individual application is required; benefits accrue through the improved roads

Required Documents

  • Not applicable
meta_title: Char Dham Highway: Better Connectivity to Pilgrimage Sites
meta_description: The Char Dham Highway project widens and strengthens roads to Yamunotri, Gangotri, Kedarnath, and Badrinath. Learn about the project.

content:
Overview

The National Infrastructure Pipeline (NIP) is a government initiative to plan and invest in infrastructure projects across India with a focus on energy, roads, railways, urban infrastructure, and digital connectivity. The pipeline provides a transparent view of upcoming projects, enabling better planning and investment. It aims to drive economic growth and create employment through sustained infrastructure development.

Eligibility Criteria

  • The pipeline covers projects across central and state governments and the private sector
  • Project proponents and investors use the NIP framework for planning
  • No individual application is required

Benefits

  • Transparent pipeline of infrastructure projects for investment
  • Better coordination between central and state projects
  • Employment generation through infrastructure construction
  • Improved public services and economic competitiveness

How to Apply

  1. Project information is available on the NIP portal
  2. Investors and project proponents engage through the prescribed project development process

Required Documents

  • As required for individual project participation
meta_title: National Infrastructure Pipeline: India's Project Investment Plan
meta_description: The National Infrastructure Pipeline plans investment in energy, roads, railways, and urban projects across India. Learn about the initiative.

content:
Overview

The Green Highways Policy of India promotes the greening of national highways through plantation along the road network. The policy directs a portion of highway project funds towards tree plantation, landscaping, and maintenance of green cover on highway land. It aims to reduce pollution, prevent soil erosion, and create green corridors across the country.

Eligibility Criteria

  • The policy applies to national highway projects and their adjoining land
  • Plantation is carried out by the implementing highway agencies
  • Local communities and agencies may participate in plantation and maintenance

Benefits

  • Tree cover along national highways reducing pollution and dust
  • Prevention of soil erosion on embankments
  • Improved aesthetics and travel experience on highways
  • Habitat support for local flora and fauna

How to Apply

  1. No individual application is required; plantation is part of highway projects
  2. Volunteers and agencies can engage through the implementing authorities

Required Documents

  • Not applicable for general beneficiaries
meta_title: Green Highways Policy: Tree Plantation Along National Highways
meta_description: India's Green Highways Policy promotes plantation along national highways to reduce pollution and soil erosion. Learn about the policy.

content:
Overview

The Industrial Corridor Development Programme is a national initiative to create industrial corridors with world class infrastructure and manufacturing hubs. The programme develops nodes along freight corridors with plug and play infrastructure, connectivity, and utilities to attract investment. It aims to boost manufacturing, create jobs, and integrate Indian industry into global value chains.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Businesses and investors can set up units in the developed industrial nodes
  • Allotment of land and facilities follows the corridor's industrial policy
  • Priority sectors vary by node as per the regional industrial plan

Benefits

  • Ready industrial infrastructure with utilities and connectivity
  • Simplified land allotment and single window approvals
  • Employment generation in manufacturing and services
  • Integration with dedicated freight corridors for logistics efficiency

How to Apply

  1. Register interest with the corridor development corporation for land allotment
  2. Submit the project proposal and investment details
  3. Complete the allotment and approvals process for the industrial node

Required Documents

  • Business registration and project details
  • Investment and financial details
meta_title: Industrial Corridor Development: Manufacturing Hubs in India
meta_description: The Industrial Corridor Development Programme creates world class industrial nodes with infrastructure and connectivity. Learn how businesses can invest.

content:
Overview

The Jawaharlal Nehru National Solar Mission (JNNSM), also known as the National Solar Mission, is a flagship programme under the National Action Plan on Climate Change. The mission promotes solar energy generation through grid connected solar parks, rooftop solar systems, and off-grid applications. It aims to establish India as a global leader in solar energy and reduce dependence on fossil fuels.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Individual households, businesses, and institutions can install solar systems
  • Grid connected and off-grid solar projects are covered under the mission
  • Developers of solar parks and large projects participate through the bidding process

Benefits

  • Subsidy support for rooftop solar installations for households
  • Net metering and feed in benefits for surplus power generation
  • Reduced electricity bills and clean energy usage
  • Support for solar parks and large scale generation

How to Apply

  1. Apply for rooftop solar subsidy through the national portal or your state discom
  2. Choose an empanelled vendor and complete the installation
  3. Receive the subsidy after inspection and commissioning

Required Documents

  • Electricity bill and consumer details
  • Identity and address proof
  • Bank account details for subsidy
meta_title: National Solar Mission: Rooftop Solar Subsidy & Benefits
meta_description: JNNSM promotes solar energy with rooftop subsidies, net metering, and solar park development. Learn how to install solar and claim benefits.

content:
Overview

Namami Gange is an integrated conservation mission for the river Ganga, launched by the Government of India in 2014. The mission combines pollution abatement, river front development, and biodiversity conservation along the river's entire length. It funds sewage treatment plants, river surface cleaning, ghat development, and afforestation projects in the Ganga basin states.

Eligibility Criteria

  • The mission benefits communities and ecosystems in the Ganga basin
  • Projects are implemented by the National Mission for Clean Ganga and state agencies
  • No individual application is required for most interventions

Benefits

  • Reduced pollution through sewage treatment infrastructure
  • Improved river front with developed ghats and public spaces
  • Conservation of aquatic life and biodiversity
  • Better health and livelihood outcomes for riparian communities

How to Apply

  1. No individual application is required under the mission
  2. Citizens can participate in cleanliness drives and awareness programmes

Required Documents

  • Not applicable for general beneficiaries
meta_title: Namami Gange: Ganga River Conservation Mission
meta_description: Namami Gange is India's integrated mission to clean and conserve the river Ganga with sewage treatment and river front development. Learn more.
